title: Ask HN: Why is HN focusing a lot on human drama and not AI solving ME problem?
content_html:
Mathematician here.

1) People love soap operas.

2) They used a lot of computing power, i.e. a lot of money. I care more about what I or my coworkers can get paying a few bucks per month.

3) For short delimited math problems, LLM are amazing, better than me, even the cheap versions. For long fuzzy problems, we still have to steer a boat. I think we still have a few year of centaur math until it's cheap enough.

4) If Magnus still can play chess, I still can do math.
